# Agent behaviour (AP-AGT)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-AGT-01

**Skipping discovery** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-01.

**Why it hurts.** Designing without the repository model produces foreign architecture.

**Fix.** Run phase 01; G1 must pass before specify.

**Detection:** phase guard (G1).

## AP-AGT-02

**Changing package versions to fix compile errors** — severity **blocker**, automated (tool), principles P-04, P-03.

**Why it hurts.** Upgrading Radzen.Blazor to make MCP guidance compile changes scope and risk.

**Fix.** Follow the fallback matrix; propose upgrades as separate scope.

**Detection:** G7 package drift check.

## AP-AGT-03

**Suppressing warnings or analyzers** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** Suppressions hide the problems gates are meant to find.

**Fix.** Fix the warning. Pre-existing suppressions are fine; new ones need a waiver with reason.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`, `*.csproj`, `*.props`, `.editorconfig`; pattern `#pragma\s+warning\s+disable|<TreatWarningsAsErrors>\s*false|\[SuppressMessage\(|<NoWarn>|dotnet_diagnostic\.\w+\.severity\s*=\s*none`.

## AP-AGT-04

**Claiming a gate passed without evidence** — severity **blocker**, automated (tool), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** Unverified claims make gate reports meaningless.

**Fix.** Report only what specs/NNN/gates/G#.json says.

**Detection:** G8 re-validation.

## AP-AGT-05

**Inventing facts** — severity **blocker**, manual review (G7), principles P-14.

**Why it hurts.** Unknown facts written as known mislead later phases.

**Fix.** Mark unknown; cite evidence for every fact.

## AP-AGT-06

**Asking trivial clarification questions** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-01.

**Why it hurts.** Questions the repository already answers waste the user’s time.

**Fix.** Decide by convention and record the evidence.

## AP-AGT-07

**Unrecorded MCP knowledge** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-15.

**Why it hurts.** Knowledge used without an evidence entry cannot be reviewed or re-verified.

**Fix.** Record every answer that informs code with speckit-radzen evidence add.

**Detection:** G4 evidence check.

## AP-AGT-08

**Waiver without reason** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** A waiver without a reason cannot be reviewed; it turns a finding into silence.

**Fix.** Add reason="…" (what makes this acceptable, and who approved it).

**Bad:**

```razor
@* speckit-radzen:ignore AP-RDZ-02 *@
```

**Good:**

```razor
@* speckit-radzen:ignore AP-RDZ-02 reason="lookup table, max 12 rows" *@
```

**Detection:** scanner: waiver syntax check.
